name: Mandala
author: E. T. Carter
description: A dense, multi-layered concentric mandala: many nested rings of glowing scalloped petals (alternating N and 2N symmetry per ring) laced together by radial spokes and studded with jewel dots, building an intricate ornament that fills the frame and breathes slowly. The line-work glows and takes graded palette hues by ring.

params.label: Petals
params.effect: Base symmetry of the mandala - the petal count of the inner rings (outer rings alternate to double this); low reads bold and graphic, high a fine lacy rose-window.

params.label: Rings
params.effect: Number of concentric ornament rings stacked from the centre out; few is a simple medallion, many a deep richly-layered mandala filling the frame.

params.label: Breath
params.effect: Speed of the slow breathing and rotation; 0 holds a perfectly still figure, higher lets the whole mandala pulse and turn gently.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness of the glowing line-work and jewels; low is a quiet etched ornament, high a luminous stained-glass rose window.
